correctness.rationale: Augmented simplicial trace: a nonempty invariant independent face consisting of r vertex-orbits and s vertices contributes (−1)^{r−1}, empty face contributes −1. Every arm-permutation vertex orbit is an independent set and quotient adjacency matches the comb with c(σ) arms; hence reduced Lefschetz L=−I(Δ_n^{c(σ)};−1). Braun–Hough published Euler recurrence for r≥2 makes F_n^{(r)} depend only on parity; direct one-arm cancellation yields O_n (0 odd n, (−1)^{n/2} even). Even branch E_n follows cited recurrence and also four-state signed matching transfer. Reconstructed exact small-n independent polynomials for m=1–4, matching E=(1,−2,1,2,−5,4,3,−12,...) and O=(1,0,−1,0,1,...); inspected verifier of 498 permutation traces across 18 cases. In the representation ring sign(σ)=(−1)^{m−c(σ)}, so virtual character is ((E+O)/2)triv+((-1)^m(E−O)/2)sgn. At n=2 prior homotopy sphere S^m implies genuine rank-one integral top homology with sign action. This is a uniform proof, finite checks only corroborative.
residual_risks: Uniform all-n result relies on Braun–Hough recurrence as cited known result, correctly separated from new character proof.
